content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause starting with "Invoices are payable Net 40", payment is due in 40 days, which exceeds the standard 30-day threshold and delays your cash flow. Please update this to: "Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law." Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to moving forward once these updates are made. Best regards,
